title: "R workflow to plot the results"
output: html_notebook

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# 1. Unseen TCR-pMHC pairs

## Read validation data results

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
result<-read.table("ensembl_NoRand_feb20_CPU.txt",header = T,sep=",")
```

## Print AUROC of unseen TCR-pMHC pairs

```{r}
print(PRROC::roc.curve((1-result$avg_rank[result$label==1]),(1-result$avg_rank[result$label==0])))
```

# 2. Read unseen TCR, similar TCR, training peptide, and training MHC lists which can be download from Zenodo <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18233675>

```{r}
#unseen TCR list
val_tcr_remain_list<-read.table("val_tcr_remain_list.csv",header = F,sep = ",")
val_tcr_remain_list<-val_tcr_remain_list$V1

#similar TCR list
val_cdr3_similar_list<-read.table("val_cdr3_similar_0.8_jaccard_inner_join_list.csv",header = F,sep = ",")
val_cdr3_similar_list<-val_cdr3_similar_list$V1

uniq_train_pep<-read.table("train_uniq_peptide_list.csv",header = F,sep = ",")
uniq_train_pep<-uniq_train_pep$V1

uniq_train_mhc<-read.table("train_uniq_mhc_list.csv",header = F,sep = ",")
uniq_train_mhc<-uniq_train_mhc$V1
```

# 3.Unseen TCR

## Read data

```{r}
rm(list=setdiff(ls(),c("val_tcr_remain_list","val_cdr3_similar_list","uniq_train_pep","uniq_train_mhc")))
result<-read.table("ensembl_NoRand_feb20_CPU.txt",header = T,sep=",")
```

## Filter data

```{r}
result$tcr<-paste(result$vaseq,result$cdr3a,result$vbseq,result$cdr3b,sep='_')
result_filtered<-result[(result$tcr %in% val_tcr_remain_list),]
```

## Print AUROC

```{r}
print(PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0])))
```

# 4.Unseen peptide

## Read data

```{r}
rm(list=setdiff(ls(),c("val_tcr_remain_list","val_cdr3_similar_list","uniq_train_pep","uniq_train_mhc")))
result<-read.table("ensembl_NoRand_feb20_CPU.txt",header = T,sep=",")

```

## Filter data

```{r}
uniq_val_pep<-unique(result$peptide)
pep_dist<-stringdist::stringdistmatrix(uniq_val_pep,uniq_train_pep)
unseen_pep_list<-uniq_val_pep[apply(pep_dist,1,min)>0]
result_filtered<-result[result$peptide %in% unseen_pep_list,]
```

## Print AUC of the validation set

```{r}
print(PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0])))
```

# 5.Unseen MHC

## Read data

```{r}
rm(list=setdiff(ls(),c("val_tcr_remain_list","val_cdr3_similar_list","unseen_pep_list","uniq_val_pep","pep_dist","uniq_train_pep","uniq_train_mhc")))
result<-read.table("ensembl_NoRand_feb20_CPU.txt",header = T,sep=",")
```

## Filter data

```{r}
result_filtered<-result[(!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)),]
```

## Print AUC of the validation set

```{r}
print(PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0])))
```

# 6.Unseen peptide and MHC

## Read data

```{r}
rm(list=setdiff(ls(),c("val_tcr_remain_list","val_cdr3_similar_list","unseen_pep_list","uniq_val_pep","pep_dist","uniq_train_pep","uniq_train_mhc")))
result<-read.table("ensembl_NoRand_feb20_CPU.txt",header = T,sep=",")
```

## Filter data

```{r}
result_filtered<-result[(result$peptide %in% uniq_val_pep[apply(pep_dist,1,min)>0]) & (!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)),]
```

## Print AUC of the validation set

```{r}
print(PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0])))
```

# 7.Unseen peptide, MHC and TCR

## Read data

```{r}
rm(list=setdiff(ls(),c("val_tcr_remain_list","val_cdr3_similar_list","unseen_pep_list","uniq_val_pep","pep_dist","uniq_train_pep","uniq_train_mhc")))
result<-read.table("ensembl_NoRand_feb20_CPU.txt",header = T,sep=",")
```

## Filter data

```{r}
result$tcr<-paste(result$vaseq,result$cdr3a,result$vbseq,result$cdr3b,sep='_')
result_filtered<-result[(result$peptide %in% uniq_val_pep[apply(pep_dist,1,min)>0]) & (!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)) & (result$tcr %in% val_tcr_remain_list),]
```

## Print AUROC

```{r}
print(PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0])))
```

# 8.Similarity vs accuracy

## Prepare data

```{r}
rm(list=setdiff(ls(),c("val_tcr_remain_list","val_cdr3_similar_list","unseen_pep_list","uniq_val_pep","pep_dist","uniq_train_pep","uniq_train_mhc")))
pep_dist_df<-data.frame(peptide=uniq_val_pep,mindis=apply(pep_dist, 1, min)) 

result<-read.table("ensembl_NoRand_feb20_CPU.txt",header = T,sep=",")
result$tcr<-paste(result$vaseq,result$cdr3a,result$vbseq,result$cdr3b,sep='_')
result$cdr3ab<-paste(result$cdr3a,result$cdr3b,sep='_')
result<-merge(result,pep_dist_df,by="peptide",all.x = T)
```

## Plot results

```{r}
plot(0, 0, type = "n", xlim = c(-0.1, 5), ylim = c(0.6, 1), 
     cex.lab = 1.2,
     cex.axis = 1.2,
     xlab = "Min. peptide distance between validation and training", ylab = "AUROC")

for (i in c(0,1,2,3,4,5)) {
  result_filtered<-result[result$mindis>=i,]
  auc<-PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0]))
  points(jitter(i, amount = 0.1), auc$auc, col = "blue", pch = 19)
}

print(nrow(result))

for (i in c(0,1,2,3,4,5)) {
  result_filtered<-result[result$mindis>=i  & (!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)),]
  auc<-PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0]))
  points(jitter(i, amount = 0.1), auc$auc, col = "green", pch = 19)
}

print(nrow(result[(!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)),]))

for (i in c(0,1,2,3,4,5)) {
  result_filtered<-result[result$mindis>=i  & (!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)) & (result$tcr %in% val_tcr_remain_list),]
  auc<-PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0]))
  points(jitter(i, amount = 0.1), auc$auc, col = "yellow", pch = 19)
}

print(nrow(result[(!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)) & (result$tcr %in% val_tcr_remain_list),]))

for (i in c(0,1,2,3,4,5)) {
  result_filtered<-result[result$mindis>=i  & (!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)) & !(result$cdr3ab %in% val_cdr3_similar_list),]
  auc<-PRROC::roc.curve((1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==1]),(1-result_filtered$avg_rank[result_filtered$label==0]))
  points(jitter(i, amount = 0.1), auc$auc, col = "orange", pch = 19)
}

print(nrow(result[(!(paste(result$mhca,result$mhcb,sep='_') %in% uniq_train_mhc)) & !(result$cdr3ab %in% val_cdr3_similar_list),]))

legend("topright", 
       legend = c("unseen TCR-pMHC (N=4872)","unseen MHC (N=264)","unseen MHC and unseen TCR (N=252)","unseen MHC and dissimilar TCR (N=175)"),      
       col = c("blue","green","yellow","orange"),         
       pch = 19,            
       bty = "n")
```
